steps.text: Litmus is the classic acid–base indicator. Let's test different solutions and watch the paper change colour.
First test an acidic solution — tap “Lemon” (lemon juice is an acid).
Notice: blue litmus turns RED. A change to red means the solution is an ACID.
Now test a base — tap “Soap” (soap solution is basic).
This time red litmus turns BLUE — that tells us the solution is a BASE.
Finally test “Water”. Neither colour changes, so water is NEUTRAL.
Because litmus responds to both acids and bases, it's a complete indicator.
